touch_window.input_mapping: production native window stretch; logical UI coordinates mapped to client coordinates at 0.75

weather_scope.coverage: selected representatives in both windows; not all twenty assets in every weather

source_observation_provenance.subsegment_semantics: A complete per-asset source segment can belong to an overall failed run. Its material/pose evidence does not turn that full run into a pass; original failures and receipts remain preserved.
source_observation_provenance.comparison_control: Original means restored native source materials in the same captured level, pose, camera and lighting; it does not mean an older deployed release.
source_observation_provenance.pose_scope: Direct native clip seeks are presentation references, not played-input combat or ecology acceptance.

live_r25.evidence: Separate live EnemyAI approach, required native body contact and recovery; controlled fixture setup, normal camera, no damage injection, health refill or quest preaward.

source_observation_provenance.m18_scope: Authored habitat/submersion context is distinct from the explicitly labelled raised dry full-body floor-seat material fixture; no aquatic behavior acceptance is inferred.

gpu_frame_time.qualitative_shared_pass_cost: Pigment grading shares the existing graded material pass and existing textures; it adds no texture files, vertices or per-actor process loops. Retained native transparent/depth passes remain unchanged. This is a qualitative per-asset cost description, not an isolated GPU measurement.

source_observation_provenance.historical_capture_runtime_scope: scripts, runtime data, shaders, scenes, original project settings and root JSON inputs; QA tool versions remain separately pinned per run
source_observation_provenance.capture_vs_delivery_scope: The 518 common leaf hashes describe historical source-capture inputs. They are not a claim that the final delivery runtime has no post-capture changes.

post_capture_hud_guard.purpose: Skip clipped minimap polygons with fewer than three vertices or no valid triangulation before draw. The valid polygon and outline drawing paths remain unchanged.
post_capture_hud_guard.comparison_scope: Only the fixed 518 historical small-text input leaves were read; no asset-directory scan, image read/hash, creature binary rehash, archive or engine operation.
post_capture_hud_guard.protected_source_scope: All recorded non-HUD text leaves, including creature data, material/shader owners, lighting and camera code, remain byte-identical if expected_hud_only_delta_confirmed is true. Protected binary-source integrity is delegated to the original source contracts and separate final-delivery verification.

final_delivery_verification.required_binding: The separate delivery receipt records source and representative native wall-frame evidence. Final built/exported bytes, frozen checks and deployment identity remain separate required stages.

source_observation_provenance.archive_attempt_note: The R1 helper failed during planning before archive-directory creation: it compared a semantic pose_sha256 declaration with PNG file-content sha256. source_observations_r1 never existed; no partial R1 directory was preserved or overwritten. The corrected source_observations_r2 historical source archive then succeeded; final-delivery verification remains separate.

archive_summary.image_binding_scope: Eight explicitly selected exact PNG exemplars are bound by source_archive_binding.json; consult the archive manifest for stored artifacts.

representative_route_performance.statistic: median of three per-run p50 and p95 wall-frame times, per zone/viewport
representative_route_performance.scope: matched native live-route source observation; adjusted prerequisite-only 1c baseline; synthetic touch, no physical phone or frozen-export acceptance

baseline.scope: Adjusted source baseline: eight explicit shared prerequisites, including unchanged1c HUD triangulation defect; no candidate monster mechanics, palette, enemy data or story interventions copied. Generated import remaps/native embedded PNG extraction are separately proven.
